criteria.description: Organizes the roadmap into Now / Next / Later (or equivalent horizons) rather than fixed dates or a Gantt chart.
Items are anchored to outcomes/problems and the metric they should move, not just feature names.
Sequencing reflects the stated strategy (winning with students), prioritizing items that serve it over those that don't.
States that confidence decreases across horizons / that Next and Later evolve with learning, so Later isn't read as a commitment.
Keeps the Now horizon focused rather than dumping most of the backlog into it.
